question.text: Within how many working days from the close of the issue must publicly offered REIT units be listed on the stock exchange?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the REIT Regulations, publicly offered REIT units must be listed on the stock exchange within 6 working days from the close of the issue. The Trap: Other timelines (3, 12 or 30 working days) do not match the REIT public issue listing rule. Note: This question is anchored to the REIT public-issue listing requirement; do not extrapolate the timeline to other product/issue types without separately verifying the source.
